title: Deadwind Pass
body: Between the dark woods of Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows lies a land with no life left in it: grey, withered trees, soil of ash, and carrion birds circling above the ravines. At its heart rises Karazhan, the tower of Medivh, the Last Guardian. When Medivh was slain within those walls, a curse settled over the tower and the country around it, and it has never lifted. Ghosts wander the tower grounds, and in the southern hills the Deadwind ogres have dug their mounds into the cliffs.

title: Deadman's Crossing
body: Deadman's Crossing is the crossroads where the road through the pass divides, back toward Duskwood, on to the Swamp of Sorrows, or south to Karazhan. Its welcome is grim. A hangman's tree stands at the junction with two corpses still hanging from it, and the signposts bear no distances, only warnings: Turn Back, and Abandon hope, all ye who enter here.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Deadman%27s_Crossing (crossroads to Duskwood, Swamp of Sorrows and Karazhan; hangman's tree with corpses; signs)

title: The Vice
body: The Vice is the southern hill country of Deadwind Pass along the road to Karazhan, and it belongs to the Deadwind ogres. Their mounds are dug into the slopes, the largest of them Grosh'gok Compound deep in the southern hills, and their camps are marked by bonfires and great cooking cauldrons. Why the ogres settled so desolate a place, so close to a cursed tower, and who leads them, no one outside the clan knows.

title: Karazhan
body: Karazhan rises at the heart of Deadwind Pass, the tower of Medivh, the Last Guardian. The fabric of the world runs thin around it, and in Medivh's day those who lived within saw vivid visions of times long past and yet to come. The darkness came with his death. Since then the tower's doors have stayed shut, its grounds have filled with wailing spectres, and ghosts haunt the abandoned church and the cellars of the servants' village below.

parts.body: Agents of the Violet Eye, the Kirin Tor's watchers over the tower, now camp at its gatehouse, seeking a way back inside.

title: Archmage Alturus
body: Archmage Alturus is a senior agent of the Violet Eye, the sect of the Kirin Tor set long ago to watch over Karazhan and its master. An old man now, he keeps his post at the tower gate with Archmage Leryda, measuring what flows from Karazhan: trace every ley line in Azeroth, he says, and all of them meet beneath it. The tower holds many secrets, and he means to lay every one of them bare.

parts.body: His readings alarmed him. Karazhan, which should pour out arcane currents of every kind, had become a void, silent but for one faint demonic echo.
sources: quest 9826 description (Violet Eye agents of the Kirin Tor watching Karazhan and Medivh, in case things got out of hand)

parts.body: His report went by way of Archmage Cedric to Khadgar, Medivh's old apprentice and one of the few who could open the sealed tower, and the one who carried it came back bearing a key to Karazhan.
